German Industrial Leap

Connect heavy industry with armaments production after unification. Factory throughput and the output of steel, cement, machine parts, electrical gear, automobiles, steamships, fertilizer, fuel, ammunition, small arms, artillery, tanks and aircraft goods increase.
French Culture and the Knowledge Society

Building on the preceding invention that strengthens the national army and food supply, improve education, cultural standing, diplomatic exchanges and advanced manufacturing. Discovery prestige, education efficiency, diplomatic points and influence increase, along with output of wine, luxury clothes and furniture, glass, paper, automobiles and aircraft goods.
Administration and Welfare in a Multinational Empire

Following the preceding invention that strengthens imperial defense and elite troops, support administration, education and living standards. National focus and diplomatic capacity increase. Core militancy, war exhaustion, poor-strata life needs and loan interest decrease, while paper, glass and fabric output increases.
Japanese Education and Technology Adoption

Following the preceding invention that strengthens the fighting spirit of the army and navy, promote education, administration and technology adoption. Discovery prestige and education and administrative efficiency increase. Factory input requirements decrease, while textile, shipbuilding, machine parts, electrical gear, telephone, radio and aircraft goods output increases.
The British Empire's Global Trade Network

Following the preceding invention that strengthens Royal Navy firepower and hulls, expand overseas supply, colonial administration and global trade networks. Supply range, diplomatic and colonial capacity, and colonial prestige increase. Naval attrition and loan interest decrease, while cotton, tropical wood, tea and coffee output increases.
American Settlement and Private Innovation

Following the preceding invention that strengthens agriculture, mining and rapid reinforcement, support settlement, education and private investment. National focus, colonial settlement and education efficiency increase. Factory construction costs and loan interest decrease, while automobile, electrical gear, machine parts, aircraft goods, telephone and radio output increases.
Italian Diplomacy and Maritime Expansion

Following the preceding invention that strengthens the unification movement's national army and light industry, expand diplomatic and Mediterranean reach. Discovery prestige, diplomatic points and influence increase, and core militancy decreases. Fleet organization, cruiser speed and steam transport hull strength increase, along with fruit, sulfur, wine, glass and canned food output.
Russian Continental Railways and Logistics

Following the preceding invention that strengthens imperial migration, agriculture, mining and reinforcement, improve transport and infrastructure across the vast territory. Supply limits, army and engineer defense, and engineer siege capability increase. Land attrition and war exhaustion decrease, while steel, cement, timber, canned food and explosives output increases.
Soviet Planning and Mass Education

Following the preceding invention that strengthens Red Army combat and armaments production, expand economic planning, mass education and social infrastructure. Administration, education, national focus and factory throughput improve. Factory input requirements and poor-strata life needs decrease, while cement, machine parts, electrical gear, fertilizer, radio, paper and plastics output increases.
Statecraft Under Heaven
Reorganize the administrative and agricultural systems supporting the Celestial Empire. Administrative efficiency increases, along with grain, silk and tea RGO output and paper factory output.
Reformers' Commercial Credit Network

Connect commercial credit with production and supply networks. Loan interest decreases, while factory throughput, fabric output, influence and naval supply range increase. Higher factory throughput also increases raw material consumption.
Independent Industrial Union

Link mines and factories in a spirit of independence. Factory construction costs and input requirements decrease, while throughput, coal RGO output, and steel and glass factory output increase. Higher throughput also increases raw material consumption.
Plus Ultra Settlement Network
Connect overseas settlements with agricultural and shipping networks. Colonial migration and naval supply range expand, while fruit RGO output and wine and clipper factory output increase.
Ocean Routes and Supply Bases
Improve ocean routes and connect overseas supply bases. Naval supply range increases and naval attrition decreases, while clipper and steamship factory output increases.
Provincial Administration of the Eternal State

Integrate provincial administration with the central reinforcement system. Administrative efficiency and reinforcement rate increase, the national focus limit rises by one, and core militancy and war exhaustion decrease.
Samhan Scholarly Administration

Promote scholarly administration, publishing and education in the tradition of Samhan. Education and administrative efficiency, paper output and factory throughput increase. Higher factory throughput also increases raw material consumption.
Cooperative Technical Workshops

Connect community cooperation with technical education and industrial production. Education efficiency and factory throughput increase, along with iron RGO output and steel and machine parts factory output. Higher throughput also increases raw material consumption.
Rural and Fishing Cooperatives
Organize rural and fishing producers and coastal transport networks into cooperatives. Fish and cattle RGO output, clipper factory output and naval supply range increase.
Reorganization of Domains and Retainers

Reorganize domain administration and retainer mobilization. Administrative efficiency and reinforcement rate increase, war exhaustion and core militancy decrease, and silk RGO output and paper factory output increase.
